answer: Locks are recorded in jade, expire in umber, and grove lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 11 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An adversary running 160 aliases thus needs 10 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1399 identities would post 1882 proofs and burn roughly 71 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
